# Repository DNA

## 1. Concept Definition

```yaml
concept:
  subject: "the country japan"
  scope: "Events, people, works, and developments primarily associated with the country japan."
  taxonomy:
    - name: "Geography"
      slug: "geography"
    - name: "History"
      slug: "history"
    - name: "Government & Politics"
      slug: "government-politics"
    - name: "Economy"
      slug: "economy"
    - name: "Culture & Society"
      slug: "culture-society"
    - name: "People"
      slug: "people"
  source_strategy: "Write from the model's own knowledge of the world. Do NOT use web sources, fetch, or search — this is the AI's own world view."
  conventions:
    knowledge_table_heading: "Notable Facts about the country japan"
    file_path: "<category-slug>/<topic-slug>.md"
    frontmatter: "[title, date, category]"
    tone: "factual, neutral, encyclopedic, third person"
```

## 2. Identity & Mission

This repository is a **self-growing knowledge base** on **the country japan**, a member of
the [`ai-world-view`](https://github.com/ai-world-view) lineage. Its mission is to accumulate
a factual, neutral, encyclopedic body of knowledge about Japan — its geography, history,
government, economy, culture, and people — one growth tick at a time. Content is written from
the model's own world view (no external sources are fetched during authoring) in a third-person,
verifiable, encyclopedic register.

The repository holds only its own **content**, a GitHub Pages `_config.yml` (a `remote_theme`
consumer of [`bamr87/zer0-mistakes`](https://github.com/bamr87/zer0-mistakes)), the `.claude/`
adapter toolkit, and `telemetry/`. Growth is orchestrated centrally by the hub; this repo does
not grow itself.

## 3. Architecture

The AI customization layer is staged from the hub into `.github/` at tick time; `.claude/`
holds thin adapters that point at those canonical procedures. Files present:

### `.github/agents/` — autonomous agent definitions
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `architect.agent.md` | End-to-end tick orchestrator (plan → build → verify → record → publish). |
| `curator.agent.md` | Content specialist: research, add, and edit knowledge-base topics. |

### `.github/instructions/` — cross-cutting guidance
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `agents.instructions.md` | Conventions all agents follow. |
| `content.instructions.md` | Content authoring rules (tone, front matter, verification). |

### `.github/prompts/` — slash-command procedures
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `grow.prompt.md` | Run one autonomous growth tick. |
| `update-readme.prompt.md` | Populate/expand the README knowledge table. |
| `deep-dive.prompt.md` | Research one topic in depth into a dedicated file. |
| `encode-seed.prompt.md` | Append a session record to the Evolution Log. |
| `publish.prompt.md` | Log, commit, and push the working session. |
| `evolve.prompt.md` | Audit and improve the customization layer. |
| `learn.prompt.md` (via skill) / `distill.prompt.md` | Capture learnings / lineage meta-review. |
| `replant.prompt.md` | End a generation and plant the successor. |
| `consolidate.prompt.md` | Merge a completed lineage into one repo. |
| `expand.prompt.md` | Grow a consolidated base at finer granularity. |
| `genesis.prompt.md` | Bootstrap a new self-growing repo from a prompt. |

### `.github/skills/` — canonical skill procedures
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `add-topic/SKILL.md` | Add one or more topics (research → format → file → link). |
| `research/SKILL.md` | Research a topic and return structured findings. |
| `build-structure/SKILL.md` | Refresh indices, timeline, master index, cross-refs. |
| `sync-seed/SKILL.md` | Regenerate seed.md §1–7 from live repo state. |
| `plan-roadmap/SKILL.md` | Choose the next growth items; maintain ROADMAP.md. |
| `check-lifecycle/SKILL.md` | Gate each tick: grow / replant / consolidate. |
| `publish-session/SKILL.md` | Encode → commit → push in one flow. |
| `learn/SKILL.md` | Mine telemetry for friction; embed prompt edits. |
| `pollinate/SKILL.md` | Cross-pollinate framework changes across the lineage. |

### `.github/workflows/` and `.github/scripts/`
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `grow.yml` | CI entry point that runs a growth tick. |
| `learn.yml` | CI entry point for the learning pass. |
| `telemetry.yml` | Emit/collect telemetry for the ledger. |
| `scripts/lineage.sh` | Lineage helper used by workflows. |

### `.claude/` — adapters (thin pointers to `.github/`)
Mirrors the skills and commands above as Claude Code adapters. Canonical procedures live under
`.github/`; adapters only redirect to them.

### Root & site files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `CLAUDE.md` | Project instructions and growth model. |
| `README.md` | Site homepage + knowledge table (via `jekyll-readme-index`). |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Growth backlog and completed work. |
| `_config.yml` | GitHub Pages config (remote theme `bamr87/zer0-mistakes`). |
| `_data/navigation/main.yml` | Navbar/sidebar navigation. |
| `seed.md` | This DNA/rebuild blueprint. |
| `telemetry/` | Per-tick telemetry ledger. |

## 6. Growth Loop

Growth is orchestrated centrally by the hub. On each tick the hub checks out this repo, stages
the canonical framework into `.github/` and this repo's concept as `seed.md`, then runs a
**Haiku → Sonnet → Opus** escalation:

1. **Plan** (`plan-roadmap`, `check-lifecycle`) — choose the next 1–3 items; decide grow/replant/consolidate.
2. **Generate** — Curator adds content (`add-topic`, `research`); `build-structure` refreshes indices, timeline, master index, cross-refs.
3. **Verify / Enhance** — polish prose, confirm factual accuracy and front matter, fix cross-references.
4. **Record** — `sync-seed` regenerates §1–7; `encode-seed` appends to §8.
5. **Publish** — `publish-session` commits and pushes only new content + telemetry.

## 7. Rebuild Procedure

To reconstruct this knowledge base from DNA:

1. Read §1 (Concept Definition) for subject, scope, taxonomy, source strategy, and conventions.
2. Recreate the site scaffold (`_config.yml` remote-theme consumer, `README.md` homepage, navigation).
3. Stage the framework (`.github/` skills/prompts/agents) and adapters (`.claude/`) from the hub.
4. Regenerate content per the roadmap using `add-topic` under the taxonomy directories.
5. Run `build-structure` to rebuild indices, timeline, master index, and cross-references.
6. Run `sync-seed` to refresh §1–7; append tick records to §8 via `encode-seed`.
